definitions.explanation: An organized group of singers who perform together, typically in parts (soprano, alto, tenor, bass). Found in schools, communities, churches, and professional settings.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{合唱団|がっしょうだん}に{入|はい}った。
{合唱団|がっしょうだん}のメンバーは{毎週|まいしゅう}{土曜日|どようび}に{練習|れんしゅう}している。
examples.english: The choir members practice every Saturday.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{合唱団|がっしょうだん}がクリスマスコンサートで{美|うつく}しいハーモニーを{披露|ひろう}した。
examples.english: The local choir showcased beautiful harmonies at the Christmas concert.

notes:
USAGE:
{合唱団|がっしょうだん} combines {合唱|がっしょう} (chorus, singing together) + {団|だん} (group). School choirs are very common in Japan, and many schools participate in {合唱|がっしょう}コンクール (chorus competitions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合唱団|がっしょうだん}に{入|はい}る (to join a choir)
- {合唱団|がっしょうだん}の{指揮者|しきしゃ} (choir conductor)
- {少年|しょうねん}{合唱団|がっしょうだん} (boys' choir)
- {混声|こんせい}{合唱団|がっしょうだん} (mixed choir)
